body: Upgrade representative fixture from PANEL tier to adjudicated tier: re-run a blind 2-model panel + adjudicator over the ~88-98 model/panel disagreements (values retrievable from columns.parquet) to localise the 8 panel-wrong flips, persist per-column verdicts, promote eval/repr/representative_corpus.tsv to llm-2panel/author tier. Needs LLM-in-the-loop opt-in. Removes the ~3pp anti-model panel bias and makes the adjudicated ~0.68 reproducible per-column.
